_comment: Curated non-item entities and the predicate vocabulary. Entities here are modelling scaffolding (concepts, regions, cultures, periods, organisations). Statements default to evidence src:gc-editorial / status needs_verification unless 'ev' is given. Dates for periods are only given where verified; otherwise omitted (unknown). Countries, continents and admin localities are NOT curated here: they are imported from the Wikidata snapshot.

predicates.label: located in
predicates.desc: Item/place is geographically within a place (modern or historical region). For movable objects: place of origin/find.

predicates.label: part of
predicates.desc: Mereology: a place within a larger place, or a structure within a larger site. Transitive; used by the hierarchy view.

predicates.label: overlaps
predicates.desc: Place partially inside another (e.g. a transcontinental country and a continent). NOT transitive, NOT used for containment.

predicates.label: broader concept
predicates.desc: Vocabulary hierarchy for concepts, periods, cultures, religions.

predicates.label: is a
predicates.desc: Top-level item type (site, settlement, monument, artefact, text...).

predicates.label: has form
predicates.desc: Physical / architectural form (pyramid, dolmen, tholos...). Independent of function.

predicates.label: has function
predicates.desc: Purpose / use (tomb, temple, dwelling...). Independent of form.

predicates.label: made of
predicates.desc: Material.

predicates.label: associated culture
predicates.desc: Archaeological culture / civilisation / people associated with the item.

predicates.label: in period
predicates.desc: Named chronological period (PeriodO-style). Period membership is a classification, not a date.

predicates.label: associated polity
predicates.desc: State, kingdom or empire under which the item was made or used.

predicates.label: associated dynasty
predicates.desc: Ruling dynasty associated with the item's creation.

predicates.label: religion / tradition
predicates.desc: Religious tradition associated with the item.

predicates.label: theme
predicates.desc: Topical theme / point of view (writing, astronomy, Seven Wonders...).

predicates.label: commissioned by
predicates.desc: Person who ordered the creation.

predicates.label: attributed to
predicates.desc: Scholarly attribution (may be disputed).

predicates.label: burial place of
predicates.desc: Tomb holds or held the burial of a person.

predicates.label: depicts
predicates.desc: Item depicts an event/person.

predicates.label: destroyed / buried by
predicates.desc: Item was destroyed or buried by an event.

predicates.label: found at
predicates.desc: Movable object's find spot (item or place).

predicates.label: held by
predicates.desc: Current keeper/collection of a movable object.

predicates.label: occurred at
predicates.desc: Event location.

predicates.label: participant
predicates.desc: Polity/person taking part in an event.

predicates.label: ruled
predicates.desc: Person ruled a polity.

predicates.label: member of
predicates.desc: Person belongs to a dynasty/family.

predicates.label: applies to region
predicates.desc: Spatial coverage of a period/culture (periods are region-specific).

predicates.label: architectural / artistic style
predicates.desc: Architectural or artistic style (e.g. Doric order, Khmer architecture).

predicates.label: named after
predicates.desc: Entity the name derives from.

entities.name: pyramidal structure
entities.description: Umbrella for pyramid-like forms that are NOT all 'pyramids' in the strict sense (ziggurats, platform mounds).

entities.name: megalithic monument
entities.description: Umbrella for structures built of large stones; 'megalithic' is a construction category, not a culture.
